title: Project Health Report
description: Output format produced by extraction scripts (e.g. extraction/pyrevit/qa_extract.py, one per model) and consumed by the Health Board dashboard. One file per project; each discipline holds one or more models, each model holds its own chronological run history. Also carries the project's role/permission definitions and the per-project config that BEP-compliance checks (naming, worksets, links) are evaluated against — this is designed to become platform-level config in a future multi-tenant SaaS, not just dashboard decoration.

config.description: BEP-derived rules that config-driven checks are evaluated against. In the SaaS platform this becomes per-project settings a BIM Manager edits; today it's authored by hand alongside the sample data.

referenceDiscipline.description: id of the discipline that owns levels/grids/coordinates (usually architecture, sometimes a dedicated survey/URS discipline). Checks that only make sense for non-reference disciplines (coordinates_acquired, copy_monitor_levels, levels_match, copy_monitor_grids, grids_match) are skipped for this discipline's own models.

model.description: Human-readable description of the model file naming convention (regex lives in the extraction script's config, not duplicated here).

expectedWorksets.description: Workset name patterns every model should have per the BEP.

expectedLinksByDiscipline.description: Map of discipline id -> array of discipline ids that discipline's models are expected to link in.

roles.description: Permission roles for the (future) multi-user SaaS platform. The current dashboard simulates these client-side with a role switcher — there is no real authentication yet.

scope.description: "project": sees every discipline. "own_discipline": sees only the discipline(s) they're assigned to.

detail.description: "full": every check category. "coordination": only categoryGroup=coordination checks. "summary": scores only, no per-check drill-down.

checkDefinitions.description: Static metadata describing each QA check, shared by every model. Values live only in a run's checks map.

id.description: Stable key, matches a key in a run's checks map

category.description: Display grouping shown as a section heading in the check grid.

categoryGroup.description: Coarser grouping used to filter checks by role (e.g. systems_coordinator sees only "coordination").

status.description: "coming_soon" checks (ACC/Forma-dependent, no license yet) are never scored and render as a muted placeholder instead of a card.

excludeReference.description: True for checks that don't apply to the project's referenceDiscipline (e.g. architecture doesn't check coordinates against itself).

goodMax.description: Required when higherIsBetter is false and status is available

goodMin.description: Required when higherIsBetter is true and status is available. Boolean checks use goodMin=warnMin=critMin=1 (pass=100/good, fail=10/critical).

disciplines.description: One entry per discipline (architecture, structure, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, landscape, ...).

models.description: One or more Revit models that belong to this discipline.

id.description: Stable key, unique within the project

history.description: One entry per extraction run against this model, chronological.

checks.description: Map of checkDefinitions[].id -> raw value for this run. Boolean checks store 1 (pass) or 0 (fail). Checks with status=coming_soon or excludeReference (on the reference discipline) are simply absent from this map.
